rows.text: • Abbott reaffirms the midpoint of previously provided full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance range and tightens the range to $5.50 to $5.55.
Abbott projects fourth-quarter 2026 adjusted diluted earnings per share of $1.62 to $1.67.
– Abbott raises full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance range to $5.45 to $5.60, compared to previous range of $5.38 to $5.58
Abbott projects third-quarter 2026 adjusted diluted earnings per share of $1.38 to $1.46 .
